breakdown.description: Thermal expansion coefficient beta for an ideal gas is approximately 1/T in absolute units (Kelvin); using Celsius temperature in beta = 1/T is incorrect.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified that the thermal expansion coefficient (beta) must be calculated using absolute temperature (Kelvin), not Celsius as the user implied. The generated specification explicitly states, 'The volumetric thermal expansion coefficient beta is evaluated as 1/T_f where T_f is in Kelvin, so beta = 1/(50 + 273.15)'. This directly corrects the error and aligns with the ground truth.
